rule_sources.rule: The sole surviving opposing minion is attacked twice by Kurtrus; the original one-attack behavior was a fixed bug.
Player-targeted Battlecries cannot select their own possessing minion; no valid target allows the minion to be played without the targeted effect.

local_policies: Ten real roots, preserved existing CORE_LOEA10_3/69723 Tinyfin and two complete evidence rows;13 original role rows and24 bilingual primary faces. All732 past-source identities/order/roles retained. No new physical child or executable-subset pool.

Patchwerk accepts and executes one ordinary random physical Minion destruction in HAND, then DECK, then BOARD, each query at its actual execution window after earlier work. Stored destructions are not discards or board deaths. Empty inventory consumes no RNG; duplicate physical cards retain their separate weights. Unknown original material fails explicitly.

Nadox uses the ordinary IF_AVAILABLE friendly current-Undead target domain, excluding the source. All-tribe and actual current tribal changes use the original shared predicate; enemy, non-Undead, dormant and departed physical victims do not qualify. Ordinary DestroyBatch and original DeathCause/DeathRecord establish actual destruction and Attack. Its current surviving friendly minions receive that Attack after the ordinary death/Deathrattle checkpoint, including actual new survivors; target immunity/prevention and same-ID reentry cannot invent a successful cause. Exact CN edge ordering remains local policy.

Finley reads original cumulative ExcavationRecord history for its actual player, not displayed tier or opponent count. At2+ it captures all active enemy Minions and uses ordinary transformations to exact existing CORE_LOEA10_3. The fixed client raw tag COLLECTION_RELATED_CARD_DATABASE_ID=69723 matches that original identity; independent first-hand28.4 datamining report also names it. Current direct CORE primary69723 is unavailable (HTTP200 empty cards), so original LOEA10_3 primary13879 verifies the same vanilla0/1/1 Murloc body, not current CORE legality or CN calibration. Existing CORE complete definition/metadata are byte-pinned unchanged.

Plush Krush has actual Charge and captures both live boards using current source/target Attack. Strictly lower Attack originals are shuffled into their physical owner decks through ShuffleOriginalMinion and one actual semantic shuffle per destination. Current controller does not overwrite owner. Original backward movement reset strips ordinary buffs, retains intrinsic material under existing policy and causes no deaths/discards. Source Attack and original eligible group are captured once; stale originals are not rebound. Dormant/non-minion occupants follow existing live selectors; exact CN edge ordering is deferred.

Theotar makes two genuine private CARD_DISCOVERY choices from complete original physical hands; duplicate faces remain separate options. First discovery selects own-hand material without creating a card, its normal discovery completion/listeners finish, then the opposing inventory is accepted. Both still-current selections transfer atomically with net hand-capacity validation before move notifications. Full hands do not burn swapped cards; original owner and ordinary hand enchantments persist. Source death does not revoke accepted continuation; departed selected original cannot rebind to a same-name card. Actual incoming physical material completes the second discovery and ordinary acquisition observers. No counterpart hand, private pair or original recipe leaks into other player DTO.

Tony captures the complete ordered original opposing deck as current CopyCard materials, removes the whole old own deck through ordinary nondeath SETASIDE removal, then creates the same ordered copies. Replacement is not discard, deck destruction or an actual shuffle. Actual captured Finale alone draws once after replacement. Benedictus uses complete original current deck copies in one ordinary semantic shuffle into its existing deck. Five playable kinds and unknown definitions keep shared copy semantics; no class/executable filter, donor consumption, new card-layer copy executor or artificial32-card truncation. Source/enchant persistence/reset follows original current-copy policy; CN edge classification stays recorded.

Blingtron equips both players using complete original collectible Weapon candidates without class filtering or executable cropping; Malkorok equips only its actual player. Both use zero bonus and original equipment/replacement/Deathrattle pipeline. Old default EquipRandomWeapons both-side+1/+1 entry remains unchanged. Unknown generated Weapon effects still raise explicit unsupported instead of filtering them out.

Kurtrus captures original source presence and both original eligible enemy edge presences. Accepted Outcast grants original current-turn Immune before both ordinary ForceAttack requests; other hand positions do not. A sole original survivor occupies both endpoints and is attacked twice, per official20.0.1 fix. Death, return/reentry or stale target does not rebind to a new edge; first combat and each death checkpoint remain shared. Taunt/Stealth and attack-quota behavior follow forced-combat policy; physical dormant/location edge interpretation remains recorded local CN edge, not a request to widen unrelated mechanics.

No formal pool/Standard/CN completeness claim. Fixed version/hotfix and CN edge testing deferred. MIS_701, YOG_522 and all six original domains remain open; current definition counts cannot substitute for actual effect or complete source closure.
